conviction_note: The lean is mildly negative and rests on a primary document. On the Q2 call the CFO said both 2026 systems ship in Q4 'resulting in some carryover revenue ... into 2027' and that system revenue is recognised over about two quarters once the site is ready. Only 57% of the $40.7m RPO converts within 12 months. Despite that, Q4 consensus still sits at ~$32m and FY at ~$42.5m, unchanged since June. Q3 consensus ($4.0-4.4m) is also above the 'up modestly' from $3.08m guide. Against that: the stock is -45% since the last print, put skew (+7.6) already pays for downside, ~21% of shares are short at 5 days to cover, and the 5-day +14% is a sector sympathy rally that can extend or fade. So p_up is 44 rather than ~38, and abs_move is 10, a little above the 8.3 implied and 8.5 median, because a Q4/FY reset and a crowded short both widen the tails. The findings sum (-1.6) and the scaled number (-1.2) agree in sign.

The estimate sources roughly agree with each other; the consensus sits above the company's own guide.
positioning_check: Short interest was 79.11m shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, about 5.0 days to cover on 15.8m average volume (https://massive.com/quote/qbts, read 2026-11-09). That is up from 70.89m (4.2 days) at 2026-09-30 and 65.9m in August (search snippets, equibles/curvedtrading). Against 379.6m shares outstanding at 2026-09-09 (424B7) that is ~21% of shares: a crowded short and still building. Options (sealed baseline): event-implied move 8.27%, 25d skew +7.61 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.52, ATM IV 132%. Tape: -16.3% over 20 days, -64% from the 52-week high, +13.95% over 5 days. The 5-day gain is mostly the Nov 6 +17% sympathy move on IonQ's beat-and-raise. Earnings Whispers puts bearish sentiment at 31% (from 22.5%) and the whisper EPS at -$0.16 against -$0.10 consensus.

findings.finding: Street Q4 2026 revenue (~$32.2m) and FY2026 (~$42.5m, unchanged since June) look out of reach on the company's own words. In August the CFO said both annealing systems (FAU $20m, SQT/Italy ~EUR10m) 'are likely to ship during the fourth quarter, resulting in some carryover revenue related to the installations and calibrations of these systems into 2027'. He also said system revenue is recognised 'on average over a two-quarter period' once the site is ready. The 10-Q says only ~57% of the $40.7m RPO (~$23.2m) converts within 12 months, against the ~$36.5m H2 that consensus needs. Any Q4 framing on the Nov 10 call that quantifies the carryover resets FY estimates toward ~$25-30m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue and timing disappointments have been sold. Q2 2026 (2026-08-06) revenue of $3.08m against a $4.03m consensus closed -9.28%, and the stock fell ~45% over the following three months. Q1 2026 was -6.99%; Q3 2025 was -8.48% even on a beat (Seeking Alpha 'slips as Q3 results top estimates').
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had priced it, the published Q4/FY consensus would have moved after the August call. TIKR shows FY2026 at $42.47m against $42.57m on June 30, so the sell-side bar was not reset. The stock has fallen 45%, so part of the disappointment is likely in the price, and the +7.6 put skew agrees with the sign. The unpriced part is the formal estimate reset that a quantified Q4 comment would force.
findings.independence: The 10-Q RPO disclosure (57% within 12 months, 72% within two years; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907982/000190798226000129/qbts-20260630.htm) is a separate document from the same company. Further support: the SQT/Italy system is a 5-year, 50%-capacity arrangement with a purchase option (https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/10/15/dwave-delivers-italy-first-annealing-quantum-computer/), which suggests ratable rather than upfront revenue. The FAU system was still described as 'coming' on 2026-10-06 (FAU article per search). The Q3 revenue finding shares the transcript.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 revenue is guided by the company only to rise 'modestly' from Q2's $3.08m, while consensus sits at $4.0-4.4m (+30-43% q/q, above Q3 2025's $3.7m). No system revenue lands in Q3 because both systems ship in Q4. That points to a fourth consecutive revenue miss (TIKR: three in a row), likely in a $3.2-3.7m range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue miss -9.28% (8-K 2026-08-06; class action cites the drop to $19.41). Q1 2026 -6.99%. The name sells revenue misses, but this one sits inside what management told the market to expect.
findings.why_not_priced: If priced, Q3 consensus would sit near $3.3-3.6m, not $4.0-4.4m. Chartmill shows the estimate cut 69% in three months, so analysts did move it, but not to the guide. Q3 revenue is ~$4m on a ~$4.4bn market cap, so the line itself carries little weight. Hence the small size.

findings.finding: No new system sale or QCaaS contract was announced during Q3 (Jul-Sep 2026). The only Q3 items were the CHIPS award (a government equity-for-grant deal, not a booking), an NSF $1.57m grant and NORDTECH funding. The Oct items are a non-binding LG CNS MOU and a Shionogi prize (no contract). Q2 bookings were only $2.1m, and H1 bookings of $35.5m were mostly Q1's $20m FAU deal and $10m Fortune 100 QCaaS deal. Q3 bookings therefore look small, unless management reveals the unnamed deals it said it had 'closed ... which we're not yet able to mention'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bookings are the line previews say the stock must show ('needs orders of its own', TIKR 2026-11-06). In the Q2 print, $2.1m quarterly bookings came alongside the -9.28% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews flag bookings as the test but give no number. If the market expected a strong Q3, there would be announced deals or a bookings whisper. Instead the 8-K trail from Aug to Nov shows only product, prize and MOU releases. This rests on an absence, so it is small, and the sign can flip if D-Wave holds deal announcements for the print, as it did in January.
findings.independence: The SEC 8-K list (Aug 3 to Nov 4, 2026; https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001907982&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40) shows only 7.01 releases on products, Qubits Asia, the Shionogi award and the solver. German coverage calls the Shionogi item 'Pharma-Preis ohne Auftrag' (https://www.boerse-global.de/d-wave-quantum-aktie-pharma-preis-ohne-auftrag/837155).

findings.finding: Delivery execution on the Q4 system is visibly on track for at least one unit. The Advantage2 'VoltaB1' arrived in Como, Italy on 2026-10-15 under the SQT EUR10m agreement and was inaugurated on Oct 16. The FAU system has no public arrival confirmation (an FAU article of 2026-10-06 still says 'coming'). The 17-qubit gate-model system was 'on track' for year end per August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on a delivery confirmation. The sweep's where_to_look flagged the risk of a slip out of Q4.
findings.why_not_priced: The Italy arrival was a trade-press item that did not move the stock, which fell through late October. A management statement that both systems shipped on schedule would remove the slip risk previews flag. It is small because the Italy unit's revenue looks ratable, and FAU is unconfirmed.
findings.independence: HPCwire and Quantum Computing Report carried the same D-Wave release (https://quantumcomputingreport.com/d-wave-delivers-italys-first-annealing-quantum-computer-to-lombardy-infrastructure-hub/). This finding uses the Italy deal structure in the opposite direction from finding 1, on timing rather than amount, and the two are consistent: the unit ships on time but its revenue is spread over years.

findings.finding: The 5-day +13.95% run-up is a sector sympathy move, not company news. QBTS rose ~17% on 2026-11-06 with no news of its own after IonQ's Q3 beat ($173.8m against $141.2m) and its FY raise to $505-515m. It followed an ~18% intraday drop on Nov 5 on a chip selloff. Rigetti reports the same morning, so the print lands on a raised, peer-driven bar that its own small numbers must hold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After strong peer tape in 2025 the stock sold its own print (Nov 2025 -8.48% on a beat). TIKR describes quantum names as 'high-beta bets on tech's mood'.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is in the baseline (+13.95% over 5 days). The unpriced part is whether a company with $3-4m quarterly revenue can justify a sympathy bid from a $174m-revenue peer. This is a proxy and inference, so it is small and could extend if Rigetti prints well the same morning.
findings.independence: IonQ results and raise (https://investors.ionq.com/news/news-details/2026/IonQ-Announces-Record-3Q26-Revenues-and-Raises-FY2026-Guidance-to-505---515-Million-as-Backlog-Grows-to-1-2-Billion/). Nov 5 selloff (https://www.tikr.com/blog/d-wave-sinks-8-rigetti-down-8-ionq-down-8-as-quantum-stocks-slide-again).

findings.finding: Financing is not a print risk. No ATM use was reported in H1 2026. Cash and securities were $546.2m at 2026-06-30, against $73.5m H1 operating burn. On 2026-09-04/08 D-Wave signed a CHIPS award of up to $100m for annealing and gate-model R&D, issuing 7.1m shares (1.9%) to Commerce, resaleable in proportion to funds drawn. The money funds the roadmap rather than covering a gap, so the sign is zero to slightly positive. The 424B7 resale is a small overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has turned on financing. The H1 2025 ATM ($536.7m) was raised into strength.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced; the award was announced in May (LOI) and September. On the print, Q3 cash (~$500m) and any award draw will confirm no near-term raise, which a few bears cite. Small.

findings.finding: A securities class action, Fessler v. D-Wave Quantum (N.D. lessons_applied: Rule 6 (inside what the company guided): the Q3 revenue miss sits inside management's 'up modestly' guide, so it was trimmed from -1.0 to -0.6.

Rule 6 and table row 'inside the guide': the Q4/FY consensus finding rests on management's own August carryover statement, so it was trimmed from -1.5 to -1.2. It keeps most of its size because the published consensus is stale against a primary document ('What has worked': a peer or company document leaving consensus stale).
Rule 7 (crowded short, skew agrees with the negative): p_up moved from 42 to 44; the short-interest finding stays at +1.0.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the CHIPS award funds the R&D roadmap, there is no ATM and cash is ample, so the sign stays slightly positive (+0.2).
